title: Zoho Desk AI Automation: Summarize Tickets Instantly with Claude #Shorts
description:
Stop wasting time on ticket histories. Use Zoho Flow and Claude AI to automatically generate 3-bullet summaries for escalated Zoho Desk tickets.

1. Create a Zoho Flow triggered when a Zoho Desk ticket status changes to 'Escalated'.
2. Add an AI step (OpenAI or Claude) passing the ticket conversation thread with a concise summary prompt.
3. Add a Zoho Desk action to publish the generated summary as a private internal comment.

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho Flow API
- endpoint: POST https://flow.zoho.com/api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/flows
- scope: ZohoFlow.flows.ALL
- docs: Zoho Flow API Documentation

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

What inspired this: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQejNncTVNQklWQkxUelh6TDFidWd4QkJWVVdscnZ4Y2ljNklaaFdOOVV0ODE0Mll6OVFUMEcwV0JzNmd1akswdW9rcFFOVHMyTmh5QTVTdWtMbEJ2Y2o0SzRLVTEtak1TYy1rNmVHLV9XdDFMUElTYUoweWM0ZFc1V3RKb1VreTM5TWZv?oc=5

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.

angle.problem: Tier-2 support engineers spend 15 minutes reading 50-comment ticket histories before resolving escalated issues.
angle.solution: Use a Zoho Flow AI step to auto-summarize long ticket threads and attach a 3-bullet briefing note on escalation.
steps: Create a Zoho Flow triggered when a Zoho Desk ticket status changes to 'Escalated'.
Add an AI step (OpenAI or Claude) passing the ticket conversation thread with a concise summary prompt.
Add a Zoho Desk action to publish the generated summary as a private internal comment.
angle.result: Saves tier-2 agents 10 minutes per ticket, accelerating complex issue resolution.
angle.wow: Engineers get a 3-bullet AI summary of 50 ticket comments the second it hits their queue.
angle.hook: Zoho Desk upgraded its tools—here is how AI summarizes long tickets instantly!
